claims.statement: In the authorization code flow, Adobe returns a refresh_token only if the offline_access scope was requested and consented to; by default a refresh token expires in 14 days. OAuth Single Page App and Native App credentials do not receive refresh tokens, and OAuth Server-to-Server credentials do not use them.

sources.supports: A refresh token is received when offline_access is requested (Web App); refresh tokens are not available for Single Page App or Native App credentials.
sources.locator: sections "OAuth Web App credential", "OAuth Single Page App credential", "OAuth Native App credential"

sources.supports: Response object: refresh_token, generated refresh token, by default expires in 14 days; only present if offline_access was requested and consented.
You do not need a refresh token for OAuth Server-to-Server credentials.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Adobe documentation read for this candidate gives no prefix, alphabet, length or other format rule for this value; any example in it is a placeholder or a public identifier. Not researched beyond existence.

The refresh-token request parameter is described as "the base64-encoded refresh token received in the response". It is not established whether that describes the token's own structure or only its transport encoding, so no alphabet is recorded.
